verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public REST API with an OpenAPI spec, and an MCP server that can send texts and pull message history. However, no API messages endpoint is documented, and there is no evidence of registrable webhooks or delivery-status callbacks. The MCP texting is a different integration surface (an adjacent feature), so it does not count as API send/receive with status callbacks.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
